description_excerpt: Job Description ABOUT YOUR ROLE The Total Quality Supervisor will maintain and ensure compliance with quality assurance programs, policies, processes, procedure. The individual will supervise the assigned team of quality engineers and technicians by providing work direction, training & influencing.
